source: model_role = the product's LEARN_TASKS key (control-plane/src/learn-models.js), read from each request (product.mjs roleOf: the one tool it sends, and its model for a routine vs escalation role), or a provider role. Roles in provisional_roles are placeholders: the material generator (/api/learn/artifact) and the Motion and Avatar stages are not exercised yet. An unlisted role is counted as unclassified, never dropped.
